RailOS Intake Flow · End-to-End Visual Audit

Ticket Raising & Guided Intake Walkthrough

Complete operational walkthrough of the department demand lifecycle in the RailOS Control Center. Shows step-by-step guidance from initial ticket intake, through location and block parameters, to structured review, Block Manager dispatch, and dashboard ledger ingestion.

Step 0: TicketsStep 1: DepartmentStep 2: CorridorStep 3: WorkStep 4: BlockStep 5: RequestedStep 6: StructuredStep 7: BlockStep 8: Updated
OVERVIEW Step 0

Tickets Hub Dashboard

Initial view of the Department Demand Hub in the Control Center. Displays active metrics (Open Requests, Awaiting Planning, Planned, Rejected) and provides the '+ New ticket' action to trigger the guided intake wizard.

INTAKE 1/6 Step 1

Department Ownership

Selecting the owning railway discipline: ENGG (Civil / P-Way), SNT (Signal & Telecom), or TRD (Traction Distribution). For track maintenance, Civil Engineering (ENGG) is designated.

INTAKE 2/6 Step 2

Corridor Location & Alignment

Configuring location bounds: Section SEC_GZB_DER (Ghaziabad-Dadri), Track line 'UP', and exact chainage boundaries from km 10.500 to km 14.200.

INTAKE 3/6 Step 3

Work Specification & Criticality

Selecting the task type (TAMPING) and urgency level (Severity 7 - High). Assets are queried from the network digital twin catalog and auto-resolved to TRACK_SEC_GZB_DER_UP.

INTAKE 4/6 Step 4

Block & Isolation Safety Needs

Specifying block requirements: 150 minutes duration (respecting HC-002 minimum runtime floors) and TRAFFIC block protection with corridor-level isolation flags.

INTAKE 5/6 Step 5

Requested Time Window

Setting operator planning preferences: earliest requested start time (09 Sep 2026, 08:00) and latest requested end time (09 Sep 2026, 14:00) for Block Finder evaluation.

INTAKE 6/6 Step 6

Structured Review & Live Preview

Final validation screen featuring the side-by-side Structured Record card. The operator reviews all captured fields before committing to the Block Manager.

COMPLETED Step 7

Block Manager Submission Confirmation

Submission success card confirming generation of canonical Ticket ID (REQ-291234A1B1) and creation of linked planning task (TKT-REQ-291234A1B1).

LEDGER UPDATED Step 8

Updated Tickets Ledger

The Tickets Dashboard is refreshed, displaying the newly created ticket with status 'REQUESTED', severity 7, and 'Ready' indicator for Block Opportunity Planner ingestion.
